name: Auto Decorator
description: Automatically decorates a layout. Pick a theme or type a prompt describing the deco you want.

default-theme.name: Default Theme
default-theme.description: Theme preselected when the popup opens.

density.name: Default Density
density.description: How much decoration is added by default.

seed.name: Random Seed
seed.description: 0 = new random result every time. Any other number gives repeatable results.

max-objects.name: Max Objects
max-objects.description: Safety cap on how many objects one run can create.

color-triggers.name: Add Color Triggers
color-triggers.description: Adds color triggers at the start that set BG/ground/line and deco channels (201-205) to the theme colors.

background-panels.name: Background Panels
background-panels.description: Adds large translucent panels behind the layout for depth.
